newsitem.title: CHINA: HK man burgled kindergarten seeking lost childhood.
newsitem.headline: HK man burgled kindergarten seeking lost childhood.

text.p: An unemployed Hong Kong man burgled kindergartens to recapture his lost childhood.

Ng Ting-pong had suffered a broken family and physical abuse as a child, and broke into the nurseries to recapture his lost infancy and harm his estranged father's name, a court heard. He stole cash and a wallet during the raids.
Ng was jailed for three years after pleading guilty to two charges of burglary, the South China Morning Post said. He had four previous convictions for breaking into kindergartens.
